title: Tiny, cute skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- grass/shadow ground -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#2a7a2a' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- skateboard deck -->
  <g transform='rotate(-6, 50, 55)'>
    <!-- deck body - bright orange -->
    <path d='M12,52 Q10,44 18,44 L78,44 Q86,44 88,52 Q90,60 82,60 L18,60 Q10,60 12,52 Z' fill='#ff8c1a' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- grip tape top - darker orange -->
    <path d='M16,47 L80,47 Q84,47 85,52 Q81,48 78,48 L18,48 Q15,48 14,52 Q15,47 16,47 Z' fill='#cc6600'/>
    <!-- deck stripe -->
    <rect x='25' y='56' width='50' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffd699' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- kicktail up -->
    <path d='M12,52 Q10,44 18,44 L22,44 Q16,44 15,50 Q14,56 18,58 Q13,58 12,52 Z' fill='#e07000'/>
    <!-- nose up -->
    <path d='M88,52 Q90,44 82,44 L78,44 Q84,44 85,50 Q86,56 82,58 Q87,58 88,52 Z' fill='#e07000'/>
  </g>

  <!-- trucks -->
  <g transform='rotate(-6, 50, 55)'>
    <!-- left truck -->
    <rect x='24' y='59' width='10' height='4' rx='1' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
    <rect x='22' y='62' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8888aa'/>
    <!-- right truck -->
    <rect x='66' y='59' width='10' height='4' rx='1' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
    <rect x='64' y='62' width='14' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8888aa'/>
  </g>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <g transform='rotate(-6, 50, 55)'>
    <!-- left wheels -->
    <circle cx='27' cy='67' r='5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='67' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='68' r='5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='68' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
    <!-- right wheels -->
    <circle cx='67' cy='68' r='5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
    <circle cx='67' cy='68' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='67' r='5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='67' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- cute face on deck -->
  <g transform='rotate(-6, 50, 55)'>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='39' cy='50.5' r='1.5' fill='#222222'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='50.5' r='1.5' fill='#222222'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M44,53 Q50,58 56,53' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ff6688' opacity='0.6'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='2' fill='#ff6688' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>
</svg>
